description:
Job Summary 
 
 Key Deliverables and Responsibilities 
 We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with expertise in Microsoft technologies (.NET, C#, Azure) to design, develop, and deploy innovative software solutions. You will work across both front-end and back-end systems, leveraging tools like React, Angular, and SQL to deliver high-
 performance solutions.

 Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain applications using Azure App Services, Functions, Blob Storage, SQL Database, and Key Vault.
 Build responsive front-end interfaces using React and robust back-end services with .NET (C#).
 Design and execute automated tests using Playwright and Bruno to ensure high-quality software delivery.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
 Optimize database queries and manage data integrity in SQL Server.
 Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices in the financial services domain.
 Design, develop, and maintain integrations between internal applications and enterprise platforms including Workday, CRM systems, financial planning platforms, and other third-party SaaS solutions.
 Build and support scalable RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations to enable secure data exchange across operational systems.
 
 What We Are Looking For 
 Proven experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-native development.
 Strong proficiency in .NET (C#), React, and SQL.
 Experience with test automation tools like Playwright and Bruno.
 Familiarity with secure coding practices and data protection in financial applications.
 
 Location: Hybrid attendance (3x/week in-office) at one of our office locations: Phoenix, AZ, Des Moines or Fairfield, IA

 Why Cambridge? 
 Cambridge has competitive benefits and promotes a work/life balance to encourage individual success.  
 Premium benefit package including medical, vision, dental, life and long-term disability insurance 
 Vacation/sick time 
 401K retirement plan with company matching program 
 Eleven paid holidays 
  
 You can find more details about our comprehensive benefits package  here .

 Cambridge Overview: 
 Cambridge is a financial solutions firm that provides business support services to thousands of independent financial advisors. These advisors offer personalized investment services including wealth management, financial planning, and retirement services to individuals and families across the country.  Cambridge provides significant compliance, technology, and transaction processing support to these financial advisors and their offices.
